name: Daniel Ortega
quote: There won't be any more elections here for them to try to seize the government and seize power.

name: Rosario Murillo
quote: Priests who oppose us are servants of Satan — full of malice, envy, ambition, and greed.

name: Denis Membreño Rivas
quote: (No public statement; designated by OFAC for service to the Government of Nicaragua under Executive Order 13851, as amended.)

name: Félix Maradiaga
role: Exiled Opposition Leader, Former Presidential Candidate
quote: The options are increasingly limited because the Sandinista dictatorship has radicalized.

name: Cristiana Chamorro
role: Exiled Opposition Leader, Former Presidential Candidate
quote: (Stripped of Nicaraguan citizenship and exiled to the United States in February 2023 after being sentenced on politically motivated charges.)

name: Juan Sebastián Chamorro
role: Exiled Opposition Leader, Former Presidential Candidate
quote: (One of seven 2021 presidential hopefuls jailed, then expelled to the US and denaturalized in February 2023.)

name: Brooklyn Rivera
role: Indigenous Rights Leader, Founder of YATAMA (d. May 30, 2026)
quote: (Held incommunicado for nearly three years after his September 2023 arrest in Bilwi; died in state custody at age 73.)

name: Bishop Rolando Álvarez
role: Bishop of Matagalpa, Apostolic Administrator of Estelí (exiled)
quote: (Sentenced to over 26 years in prison in Feb. 2023 for denouncing the government; deported to the Vatican in January 2024 and confirmed by Pope Francis as bishop 'in the diaspora.')

name: Bishop Juan Abelardo Mata
quote: (Prayed for the country's 'persecuted Church' at a June 28 Mass; detained the next day at El Chipote prison.)

name: Bishop Carlos Herrera
role: President, Nicaraguan Bishops' Conference; Bishop of Jinotega (exiled)
quote: (Expelled after criticizing a regime-aligned mayor who disrupted a Mass he was celebrating.)

name: Pope Leo XIV
quote: (Received exiled Bishop Rolando Álvarez in a Vatican audience, a gesture read as papal solidarity with Nicaragua's persecuted Church.)

name: Marco Rubio
quote: The circumstances of Brooklyn Rivera's death in custody were horrific.

name: María Elvira Salazar
role: US Representative, Co-Sponsor of Nicaragua Sanctions Legislation
quote: (Co-introduced the Restoring Sovereignty and Human Rights in Nicaragua Act of 2026 to expand targeted sanctions over the crackdown on the Catholic Church and opposition.)

name: Ted Cruz
role: US Senator (R-TX), Co-Sponsor of Nicaragua Sanctions Legislation
quote: (Co-introduced with Sen. Tim Kaine the Restoring Electoral Fairness and Opposition Rights through Mandates for Accountability Act, building on the NICA Act framework he authored in 2018.)

name: Albert Ramdin
role: Secretary General, Organization of American States
quote: The Nicaraguan regime has now made explicit what its actions had long demonstrated: it has abandoned democracy, even the pretense of it.

name: Volker Türk
role: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights
quote: (Sought clarification and independent verification of Bishop Abelardo Mata's condition after weeks passed with no confirmed sighting.)

name: Jason Puracal
role: US Citizen Wrongfully Detained 2010-2012 (case decided by Inter-American Court, Aug. 2026)
quote: (Raided and arbitrarily detained without a valid warrant in November 2010; held over 21 months in inhumane conditions. The Inter-American Court ruled Nicaragua internationally responsible in August 2026 and ordered reparations.)

name: Isaías Castro Ruiz
quote: (Held in solitary confinement in the Juigalpa penitentiary since his Dec. 3, 2021 arrest; the IACHR granted precautionary measures Aug. 16, 2026 citing threats to his life, health and integrity.)
